summary:
Turn 56 reproduced a new codec contract break and recorded it, together with the exact framing constraint that blocked filing it as a check this turn.

The finding. The command value codec frames a value's length in a two-byte field on both sides of the marshalling, while the client's command size is configuration-driven (aws.conf sets 1000; the field allows up to 65535). A locally run harness marshals a 70000-byte value and unmarshals from the same buffer: 70013 bytes on the wire, 4464 bytes decoded (70000 modulo 65536) and only 4477 bytes consumed, so the value is silently shortened and the remaining 65536 bytes stay in the reader's stream, shifting every following message boundary. The harness (explore_value_len_test.go) is in the draft and runs clean.

Why it is not yet a formal check. The submission was rejected on framing rather than on substance: the validator requires the question's selected behavior and principal fact to carry the A1 or A2 relationship the map attributes, and the codec's material does not sit on any of the behaviors/facts I could pair with it without mislabeling (B16-client-reply with F7-durable-bytes failed the relation test, and pairing the codec with F5-pending-proposal left the A1/A2 explanation unsatisfied). Rather than iterate blindly, the constraint is recorded verbatim so the next attempt frames it correctly — either by attaching the codec to the behavior/fact the map already attributes to command framing, or by filing it as an explicit supporting-layer question with a declared A1/A2 link.

The codec and configuration ranges are registered as sources, the bounded importance is stated (the shipped configuration's 1000-byte commands are inside the field's range, so the default deployment never reaches the truncation), and the two follow-up unknowns are recorded: whether the client library caps the value size it builds, and what a replica reader does on the following message once the stream is shifted. No map object changed, the nine settled claims and two paused candidates are untouched, and no requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened.
